card.line: Nazareth was a town in Galilee where Mary lived and Jesus grew up, and where He was rejected when He first taught in the synagogue.

moments.title: Gabriel Visits Mary
moments.text: God sent the angel Gabriel to Mary, a virgin pledged to Joseph. He told her she would give birth to a Son named Jesus, the Son of the Most High. Mary answered, "I am the Lord's servant."

moments.title: Joseph Settles Here
moments.text: After an angel told Joseph in a dream to leave Egypt, he feared Archelaus. Warned in a dream, he took the Child and His mother to live in Nazareth.

moments.title: Jesus Grows Up
moments.text: After the family returned from the temple in Jerusalem, the Child grew strong and wise in Nazareth. After being found in the temple at twelve, Jesus went down to Nazareth with His parents and was obedient to them.

moments.title: Jesus Reads Isaiah
moments.text: On the Sabbath Jesus stood in the synagogue and read from Isaiah. He said, "Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing." The people were enraged by what He said next and drove Him out of town to throw Him off a cliff.

moments.title: Can Anything Good Come?
moments.text: Philip told Nathanael that they had found the One Moses and the prophets wrote about, Jesus of Nazareth. Nathanael asked if anything good could come from Nazareth. Philip said, "Come and see."
